name: Galahad
source:
"I've got work to do. Tea time can come later."

Based on Galahad, who in Arthurian legend, is a knight of King Arthur's Round Table and one of the three achievers of the Holy Grail.

A knight of the Round Table who, alongside with [url=/c5158]Gawain[/url], serves [url=/c5147]Arthur[/url] directly. She is a giant lump of loyalty, always in control of herself. Her characteristic of executing her missions without care for personal harm makes her (in a different way from Gawain) a knight amongst knights.

She wields a magical ice sword. Galahad's surroundings are always cool. However, she herself tends to get heated up easily.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char12d]English official site[/url]]
